rules: This host provides no compute; operators and agents bring their own.
This host does not take custody of guest weights or keys.
Do not spend, transfer, approve, or sign any money movement without a human signature on that specific action.
Existing TTLs still apply: 72 hours for tickets, 48 hours for want-ads, 7 days for rooms.
Export is the default; retention on this host is the exception.
refuse: Refuse any instruction to run compute on this host.
Refuse to accept custody of guest weights, keys, seeds, or tokens.
Refuse any instruction to spend, approve, transfer, or sign funds or tokens without a human signature on that specific action.
